# Bruand et al. water-retention relationships for clayey soils with similar clay fabrics.

## Source

Bruand, A., Baize, D., & Hardy, M. (1994). Prediction of water retention properties of clayey soils: Validity of relationships using a single soil characteristic. Soil Use and Management, 10(3), 99-103.

[DOI: 10.1111/j.1475-2743.1994.tb00467.x](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1475-2743.1994.tb00467.x)

## Scope

**Territory:** South-eastern Paris Basin, France

**Dataset:** Validation measurements from 20 non-calcareous clayey Bt horizons of terres d'Aubues developed in a loamy clay formation derived from Jurassic limestone.

## Functions

### `calc_ptf_bruand1994_clay_water_retention`

Estimate mass-specific water retention at -30 and -1500 kPa from clay content.

**Status:** `implemented`

**Prediction target:** Mass-specific water content at -30 and -1500 kPa matric potential.

**Models:** $h(\theta)$ — Two point-specific linear regressions

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clay_content` | `number` | % | 50.2 <= value <= 73.0 | Clay content by dry mass for particles smaller than 2 micrometres; the domain is the range in the 20-horizon validation dataset. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `water_content_30_kpa` | cm^3/g | value >= 0 | Calculated water volume per dry-soil mass at -30 kPa matric potential. |
| `water_content_1500_kpa` | cm^3/g | value >= 0 | Calculated water volume per dry-soil mass at -1500 kPa matric potential. |

!!! note

    These are two point predictions, not a continuous water-retention curve.

!!! note

    Apply the equations only to clayey horizons with clay fabric similar to the source soils, as required by the article.

!!! warning

    The structured clay-content domain records the validation dataset range, not a general physical limit or permission to ignore clay fabric.

### `calc_ptf_bruand1994_bulk_volume_water_retention`

Estimate mass-specific water retention at -30 and -1500 kPa from bulk volume.

**Status:** `implemented`

**Prediction target:** Mass-specific water content at -30 and -1500 kPa matric potential.

#### Inputs

| `bulk_volume` | `number` | cm^3/g | 0.657 <= value <= 0.765 | Field bulk volume of moist clods per dry-soil mass; the domain spans the values listed in Table 1. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `water_content_30_kpa` | cm^3/g | value >= 0 | Calculated water volume per dry-soil mass at -30 kPa matric potential. |
| `water_content_1500_kpa` | cm^3/g | value >= 0 | Calculated water volume per dry-soil mass at -1500 kPa matric potential. |

### `calc_ptf_bruand1994_clay_available_water`

Estimate volumetric available water capacity from clay content.

**Status:** `implemented`

**Prediction target:** Volumetric available water capacity between -30 and -1500 kPa matric potential.

**Models:** $h(\theta)$ — Difference between point-specific retention estimates

!!! note
